limitations: Fresh HOME and a shell echo benchmark; runtime fast-path logs also include three incidental writes to agent-1 (115 shell writes, 118 total). Production restored Work/error-ledger workload was not reproduced.
Echo timing includes shell execution, backend output delivery and animation-frame polling.
Theme timing includes Playwright click actionability and browser confirmation.
No before/after performance comparison: this run validates instrumentation and pane-count observations only.
macOS was examined by common source path, not runtime sampling.
